messages:
Iris: quick round on the Compliance > Data lifecycle mock. attaching a tiny screenshot and layout notes.
Ben: thanks — what's the short list of UX nits?
Iris: 1) on narrow view the retention control is tucked under a long paragraph; can we make it a compact inline pill next to region? 2) the encryption badge text says 'Customer key' which users misread as stored by Redwood.
Sofia: for 2) i've been recommending 'Key custody: Customer (BYOK)' — explicit and still short. hover: 'You control the encryption key; Redwood does not have access to key material.'
Alex: inline pill sounds good. also had feedback: a tiny 'retention estimator' under the selector like "~3.2k objects (~120MB) affected" helps customers gauge impact before saving.
Ben: love the estimator idea, maybe behind a FF. microcopy for retention label: 'Remove data after' vs 'Auto-delete after' — any preference?
Sofia: 'Remove data after' felt more action-oriented in interviews. propose helper: 'Files and embeddings will be removed after this period; exports for legal requests may persist per policy.'
a11y-bot: a11y check: badge icon contrast 2.2:1 on light theme (fail). Options: darker icon (#0E2535) or include text label; ensure icon has descriptive alt text.
Iris: also audit log column currently shows raw event ids like `data.cleanup` — request: surface friendly phrasing in the table, e.g. 'Scheduled cleanup ran', with raw id in the JSON details view.
Alex: agreed. timeline format: show local timezone + relative, e.g. 'Apr 12 2026, 17:21 BST — 3h ago'. add a table header toggle to switch to UTC.
Ben: keyboard flow note: ensure tab order is toggle -> region -> retention -> estimator -> KMS. retention changes should announce via aria-live: 'Retention set to 30 days'.
Sofia: confirm modal copy: replace 'Are you sure?' with 'Permanently remove data after [X days]? This action is irreversible.' include a link to the retention policy and a second line: 'Consider exporting data first.'
Alex: backend already stores raw event types; we'll map to friendly labels in front-end with fallback to raw string.
Iris: will mock the inline pill + estimator and push a tiny PR. tagging @Sofia @Ben for copy and @Alex for implementation.
Ben: i'll do copy pass tomorrow morning.
Sofia: i'll run an a11y sweep once the branch is ready. remind me to check contrast on dark and light themes.
a11y-bot: accessibility reminder: ensure retention dropdown is keyboard-operable (arrow keys) and that the estimator region is reachable and announced appropriately.
Iris: created follow-ups in tracker: UX-2201 (compact retention + estimator) and SEC-812 (key custody phrasing + badge contrast). thanks :thumbsup:
